epitaph.definition:
n. an inscription on a tombstone or monument in memory of the person buried there
n. a summary statement of commemoration for a dead person

n. 墓志铭, (墓)碑文；纪念往事(或死者)的简短(诗)文, 墓志铭体小诗(或短文)
